title: A Summer to Remember
note: 測試卷（過去式＋未來式）；正式版每平日 20:00 自動更新。
passage:
Last summer, my family took a trip to Kenting in the south of Taiwan. We stayed at a small hotel near the beach. Every morning, we swam in the clear blue sea and built sandcastles. My dad rented a scooter, and we rode along the coast to watch the sunset. One evening, we ate fresh seafood at a night market, and I tried grilled squid for the first time.

We also visited an ocean park, where we saw dolphins and colorful fish. My little brother was scared of the big sharks, but I thought they were amazing. On the last day, it rained heavily, so we stayed inside and played card games. Even the rain could not ruin our happy trip.

This summer, we are going to travel again, but this time we will fly to Japan. My mom has already booked the hotel, and we are going to visit Tokyo and Kyoto. I will try real Japanese ramen, and my brother is going to see a famous castle. I am going to keep a travel diary so that I will never forget it. I believe this summer will be even better than the last one!

grammar: 一般過去式 Simple Past：描述過去發生的事（took, stayed, swam, rode, ate, saw, rained…）。
未來式 Future：be going to（計畫）與 will（意願/預測），如 are going to travel、we will fly。

opts: Kenting in the south of Taiwan

reading.ex: I tried grilled squid for the first time。

reading.q: Why did they stay inside on the last day?
reading.ex: On the last day, it rained heavily。

reading.q: Where are they going THIS summer?
reading.ex: we will fly to Japan... Tokyo and Kyoto。

reading.q: What will the writer keep during the trip?

grammar.q: Last summer, we ______ a trip to Kenting. (take)
This summer, we ______ fly to Japan.
grammar.ex: 未來意願/預測用 will + 原形 fly。

grammar.q: My brother ______ see a famous castle. (be going to，計畫)
grammar.ex: 既定計畫用 be going to；he → is going to + 原形。

grammar.q: Which sentence is in the PAST tense?
opts: We ate seafood at the night market.
grammar.ex: ate 是 eat 的過去式，其餘為未來式。
